title: Silent Movie Star
instructions: Act out the Christmas movie or TV special on your phone for your team. No words, no sounds, no mouthing, no pointing at things in the room. Your team shouts guesses.

secret.label: Act out this Christmas movie or TV special, silently
options: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
Santa Claus Is Comin' to Town

judge: Team says the title within 60 s (close enough counts, e.g. 'Christmas Vacation', 'The Grinch' or 'Rudolph'); any word, sound or mouthing from the performer = fail.

title: Santa Belly Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stuff a pillow up your untucked shirt for a Santa belly. No hands on the pillow! Do 10 jumping jacks (or 10 squats, hands on your head). If it drops, start over!
judge: 10 in a row with the pillow still in place and no hands on it within 60 s; 5 or more in a row = partial.

title: Two-Headed Santa
instructions: PAIR: link arms. You are now ONE Santa. The host picks 3 people from other teams to ask Santa a question. Answer each in a full sentence, one word each, taking turns.
judge: Three answers, each a full sentence, strictly alternating one word per player; two good answers = partial.

title: Banned Words
instructions: Get your team to say the word on your phone. Don't say any part of it or any of the banned words shown with it. No gestures, no 'sounds like'.

secret.label: Get your team to say this word. Never say the banned words!

judge: Team says the exact word within 30 s; saying a banned word or part of the answer = fail.

title: Reindeer Poker Face
instructions: WHOLE TEAM: hands on heads like antlers, straight faces, for 30 seconds. Other teams may pull faces and make noises from an arm's length away. No touching!
judge: Nobody on the team laughs out loud or drops their antlers for 30 s; exactly one person cracks = partial.

title: Cookie Face-Off
instructions: FACE-OFF against a challenger the host picks from another team. Cookie on your forehead: get it into your mouth using only your face. No hands! Dropped it? Put it back and keep going.
props: 2 small, firm cookies (a cracker works for anyone avoiding cookies)
judge: Active player's cookie reaches their mouth before the challenger's; gets it there within 60 s but second = partial.

title: Who Am I?
instructions: Become the character on your phone: talk, move and act like them in the situation shown. Never say their name. Your team guesses who you are.

secret.label: Become this character. Never say their name!
options: Santa Claus, stuck in a chimney
Mrs. Claus, bossing the elves around
The Easter Bunny, jealous of all the attention Santa gets
An overexcited kid at 5 a.m. on Christmas morning
A turkey who just found out what's for Christmas dinner
Olaf from Frozen, dreaming about summer
A gingerbread man, running away from everyone
A nutcracker soldier, on guard duty
An elf on the shelf, caught moving
A reindeer, on its first day at flight school
Jack Frost, painting frost on the windows
A Yeti, trying to be polite at a fancy party
A snowflake, falling for the very first time
A shopping-mall Santa, on his last nerve
The angel on top of the tree, scared of heights
A cat in a Santa hat, very unimpressed

judge: Team names the character within 45 s (close enough, host's call; e.g. 'Olaf' or 'a reindeer'); the performer saying the name = fail.

title: Slow-Mo Snowball Fight
instructions: WHOLE TEAM: stage an epic snowball fight in SLOW MOTION. Slow-motion voices, slow-motion faces, and at least one dramatic slow-motion hit. Nobody speeds up!
judge: Whole team stays in slow motion for 30 s with at least one dramatic 'hit'; anyone drifting to normal speed = partial.

title: Stand-Up Santa
instructions: Tell the terrible Christmas joke on your phone like a stand-up superstar. Other teams: keep a straight face! Make at least 2 of them laugh out loud. Smiles and groans don't count!

secret.label: Deliver this joke like a stand-up superstar
options: What do you call a snowman with a six-pack? An abdominal snowman.
Who delivers presents to baby sharks? Santa Jaws.
What does Santa do in his garden? Hoe, hoe, hoe!
What do you call a cat on the beach at Christmas? Sandy Claws.
What do you get if you cross a snowman with a vampire? Frostbite.
What do you call a deer with no eyes? No idea!
How do sheep say Merry Christmas? Fleece Navidad!
What do elves learn at school? The elf-abet.
What kind of motorbike does Santa ride? A Holly Davidson.
Why did the turkey join the band? Because it had the drumsticks.
What kind of music do elves like best? Wrap music!
Why did Santa's helper go to the doctor? Low elf-esteem.
Why was the Christmas tree bad at knitting? It kept dropping its needles.
What do you call an old snowman? Water.

judge: At least 2 players from other teams laugh out loud within 30 s (smiles and groans don't count); exactly 1 = partial.

title: Candy Cane Fishing
instructions: Stand 3 candy canes hook-up in a mug. Hold a 4th in your mouth, hook out, and use it to move them one at a time into a second mug. No hands!
judge: All 3 candy canes land in the second mug within 60 s without hands; 1 or 2 moved = partial.

title: Mime Telephone
instructions: WHOLE TEAM: line up, backs turned, except Player 1, who has the phone. Player 1 taps the next player and silently mimes the activity; they mime it to the next, and so on. Last player guesses! No sounds!

secret.label: Silently mime this to the next teammate
options: Putting the star on top of the tree
Ice skating for the first time
Assembling a toy with no instructions
Sneaking downstairs to peek at the presents
Leaving cookies and milk out for Santa
Wrapping a present that won't stay closed

judge: The last player names the activity (close enough) within 90 s; right general idea = partial (host's call); any word or sound = fail.

title: Santa Says
instructions: Lead the WHOLE ROOM (seated or standing) in 'Santa Says'. Anyone who obeys a command that doesn't start with 'Santa says' is out. Catch 3 players from other teams. Gentle moves only!
judge: At least 3 players from other teams are caught within 45 s; 1 or 2 caught = partial.

title: Soap Opera Moment
instructions: Read the line on your phone aloud like the star of a dramatic soap opera: gasps, long pauses, a stare into the distance. No giggling!

secret.label: Read this aloud like a soap-opera star
options: Gravy. You promised me gravy. And now... the gravy boat is EMPTY.
I have a confession. I re-gifted your present. It was the candle YOU gave ME last year.
Someone ate the last chocolate in the advent calendar... and that someone... was ME.
The batteries. The toy needs batteries. And the batteries... are NOT included.
You put the star on the tree... without me? After everything we've been through?
These are not my slippers. Whose slippers are these? WHOSE SLIPPERS ARE THESE?
You said it was 'one size fits all.' It does not fit all. It does not fit... ME.
The Wi-Fi password. Please. I'm begging you. Tell me the Wi-Fi password.
I asked for a pony. And you got me... a PICTURE of a pony.
The Brussels sprouts. Nobody eats them. And yet, every year... there they are.
The TV remote is gone. Someone sat on that couch... and now it's gone forever.
You opened my present before Christmas morning? I don't even know who you are anymore.
The cookies are gone. The crumbs lead to this room. And one of you... has a milk mustache.

judge: Reads the whole line with at least one gasp, one dramatic pause and one stare into the distance, without giggling.

title: Snowman Wrap
instructions: WHOLE TEAM: wrap one teammate in toilet paper to turn them into a snowman, from shoulders to knees. Keep the face clear! Finish with a snowman pose.
judge: At the buzzer, the snowman is wrapped from shoulders to knees with no gap bigger than a hand (host checks from the front); mostly covered = partial.

title: Sound Effects Only
instructions: Make the sounds of the scene on your phone. Noises only: no words, no singing, and keep your hands behind your back. Your team guesses the scene.

secret.label: Make the sounds of this scene. No words, no hands!
options: Blowing up an inflatable lawn Santa
A car that won't start on a frozen morning
Dropping a whole tray of Christmas cookies
Fireworks at midnight on New Year's Eve
A cat knocking ornaments off the tree
A toddler opening a present that turns out to be socks
Popping a whole sheet of bubble wrap
A sleigh crash-landing in the snow

judge: Team names the scene (close enough, host's call) within 45 s from the performer's noises alone.

title: Christmas Rap Battle
instructions: FACE-OFF: the host picks a rapper from another team. You go first. 20 seconds each, rapping about Christmas, using the words 'turkey' and 'chimney'. The room claps a beat. Louder cheer wins!
judge: Raps for about 20 s using both words and wins the louder cheer; raps with both words but loses the cheer = partial.

title: Living Christmas Card
instructions: Show the scene on your phone to your team only. Take 15 seconds to pose as that Christmas card, then FREEZE. The other teams shout guesses. First to guess right wins 50 too!

secret.label: Show only your team, then freeze as this Christmas card
options: Carol singers at the front door
Kids catching Santa in the living room
Elves on a toy production line
Everyone asleep on the couch after Christmas dinner
Hanging up stockings by the fireplace
Shoppers grabbing the last toy on the shelf
Waiting in line to see Santa

judge: Another team names the scene (close enough) within 45 s while the team stays frozen and silent, and the host gives the guessers 50; nobody gets it = host reveals the card, a clear match = partial.

title: Spoon on the Nose
instructions: Hang a spoon from the tip of your nose, no hands, for 10 full seconds while the room counts. Tip: breathe on the spoon and tilt your head back first.
judge: Spoon hangs from the nose, hands-free, for a 10-second room count within 45 s; 5 seconds or more = partial.

title: Secret Voice
instructions: Read this line in the secret voice on your phone: 'Dinner is in five minutes, the turkey is enormous, and nobody touches the last cookie!' Repeat it as often as needed. Team guesses the voice.

secret.label: Read the line on the TV in this voice
options: An airline pilot making an announcement

judge: Team names the voice (close enough) within 45 s; the performer only says the line and never describes the voice.

title: Boy Band Debut
instructions: WHOLE TEAM: sing the first verse of 'Deck the Halls' as a boy band, with one synchronized dance move, one dramatic solo line, and a big final pose.
judge: Everyone sings the verse with a synchronized move, a solo line and a final pose; missing one of the three = partial.

title: The Worst Gift Ever
instructions: You just unwrapped the terrible gift on your phone. Be wildly OVERJOYED: gush, hug it, explain how you'll use it, but never say what it is. Your team guesses the gift.

secret.label: React with pure joy to this gift. Never say what it is!
options: A framed photo of the person who gave it
A sweater for a dog (you don't have a dog)
A singing fish on a plaque

judge: Team names the gift (close enough) within 45 s while the performer stays joyful; saying the gift's name = fail.

title: Wildlife Documentary
instructions: PAIR: one whispers like a nature-documentary narrator; the other is the 'camera crew', tiptoeing up to each 'wild animal'. Narrate the room in its natural habitat. Feature at least 3 people. Keep it kind!
judge: 30 s of nonstop whispered narration featuring at least 3 people while the 'camera crew' sneaks up on each; giggling or breaking character = partial.

title: Nose the Present
instructions: Push a small box from one end of a cleared table to the other and back, using only your nose. No hands! Falls off? Put it back where it fell.
judge: Box reaches the far end and comes back within 60 s, touched only by the nose; one way only = partial.

title: Genre Swap
instructions: Sing the chorus of 'Jingle Bells' in the music style on your phone. Commit fully, but never say the style! Your team guesses it.

secret.label: Sing the 'Jingle Bells' chorus in this style

judge: Team names the style (close enough) within 45 s while the performer sings the real words; saying the style = fail.

title: Helping Hands
instructions: PAIR: Player 1 puts their hands behind their back; Player 2 stands behind and becomes their arms. Host a cooking show: 'How to bake perfect Christmas cookies.' Mime everything. End with a taste test.
judge: Player 1 talks for the full 45 s while Player 2's arms act it all out, ending with a taste test; long silences, giggling fits or no taste test = partial.

title: One-Breath Ho Ho Ho
instructions: Take ONE deep breath, then say 'Ho ho ho, Merry Christmas!' as many times as you can before you breathe again. The whole room counts out loud.
judge: 8 or more full phrases on one breath; 5 to 7 = partial.

title: Plate-Head Picasso
instructions: Put a paper plate on your head and draw the thing on your phone on it, without looking. No talking, no gestures, no letters or numbers. Your team guesses.

secret.label: Draw this on the plate on your head

props: A paper plate (or paper on a hardback book)
judge: Team names the drawing within 45 s; talking, gesturing or writing letters/numbers = fail.

title: The Maestro
instructions: Give each team a Christmas sound (jingle, ho-ho-ho, reindeer stomp, howling wind, or invent more). Then CONDUCT the room: cue each team, go loud, go soft, then cut everyone off with one fist.
judge: Every team plays on cue with a loud-to-soft change, and the room goes silent at once on the final cut-off; a ragged cut-off = partial.

title: Jingle Jiggle
instructions: Tie an empty tissue box to your lower back with a belt or scarf, with 5 small items inside. Wiggle, jiggle and jump until every item is out. No hands!
props: 5 ping-pong balls, wrapped candies or balled-up socks
judge: All 5 items out of the box within 60 s without hands; 3 or 4 out = partial.

title: Late-Night Infomercial
instructions: PAIR: make a 30-second TV ad for the secret product shown on your phone. One is the over-the-top host, one the amazed customer. Say its name, invent a slogan, give a price, and shout 'But wait, there's more!'

secret.label: Sell this product together. Say its name loud and proud!
options: Canned snow for people in hot countries
A robot that writes your thank-you notes
A sled with seat belts and airbags
A Christmas tree that waters itself
A cookie jar with a lie detector
Inflatable guests to fill empty chairs at dinner
A doorbell that only rings for Santa

judge: The 30 s ad includes the product name, a slogan, a price and 'But wait, there's more!' with both players in character; two or three of the four, or breaking character = partial.

title: Christmas A to Z
instructions: WHOLE TEAM: take turns in order, each saying a Christmas word that starts with the next letter: A, B, C... Stuck for 3 seconds? The next teammate takes that letter. Reach M!
judge: The team gives a Christmas word (host's call) for every letter A through M within 60 s; getting at least A through G = partial.

title: Tongue Twister
instructions: Say 'Santa's short suit shrunk' five times fast, out loud and clear, without a single slip. You get two tries.
judge: Five clean repetitions in a row, at speed, on either try; three or four clean in a row = partial.

title: Oven-Mitt Wrap
instructions: Wearing oven mitts, wrap the box in paper using the pre-torn tape strips. The mitts stay on the whole time! No cardboard showing at the buzzer.
props: 6 strips of tape, pre-torn and stuck to the table edge
judge: No cardboard visible and the paper stays on when the host lifts the box; mostly covered = partial.

title: Christmas Catwalk
instructions: PAIR: the model struts a runway across the room in the secret walk style on their phone: 3 poses, there and back. The partner commentates like a fashion-show host. Your team guesses the style!

secret.label: Strut the runway in this style. Don't tell your partner!
options: A toddler in a puffy snowsuit
Santa, very full after Christmas dinner
A superhero coming in to land
A cat that just woke up
Someone carrying way too many shopping bags
Someone walking into a freezing blizzard

judge: The team names the walk style (close enough) within 45 s while the model struts and the partner keeps commentating; right general idea = partial; the model saying the style = fail.

title: Interpretive Dance
instructions: Perform an interpretive dance called 'The Life of a Christmas Tree': grow from a tiny seedling, get chopped down, decorated, admired, then dragged to the curb in January. Topple gently: no hitting the floor!
judge: All five stages (seedling, chopped, decorated, admired, curb) shown with full commitment within 45 s; three or four stages, or giggling out of character = partial.

title: Whole-Room Freeze Dance
instructions: EVERYONE dances to Christmas music, seated or standing. When the host pauses it, FREEZE. Anyone still moving, or the last to freeze, is out. Three rounds.
props: A phone or speaker playing Christmas music
judge: After round 3, at least half the active team is still in; at least one active-team player still in = partial.

title: Classic Special Rehearsal
instructions: Act out the famous moment from a classic Christmas TV special on your phone. Sound effects are fine (honks, growls, ho-ho-hos), but no real words. Your team must name the special AND the moment.

secret.label: Act out this moment. Sound effects only, no words!
options: Rudolph (1964): Hermey the elf tells his boss he wants to be a dentist
Rudolph (1964): Rudolph's fake nose pops off at the Reindeer Games
Rudolph (1964): Clarice says Rudolph is cute, and he soars into the air with joy
Rudolph (1964): Yukon Cornelius throws his pickaxe into the snow, then licks it
Rudolph (1964): Hermey pulls the Abominable Snow Monster's teeth
Rudolph (1964): An elf drops the Misfit Toys from Santa's sleigh with umbrellas
A Charlie Brown Christmas: Charlie Brown hangs one ornament on his little tree and it droops
A Charlie Brown Christmas: Linus recites the Christmas story on stage and drops his blanket
A Charlie Brown Christmas: Snoopy kisses Lucy and she panics about dog germs
A Charlie Brown Christmas: The gang dances on stage while Schroeder plays piano
A Charlie Brown Christmas: Lucy runs her 5-cent psychiatric help booth
How the Grinch Stole Christmas (1966): The Grinch gets his 'wonderful, awful idea' and grins a huge, sly grin
How the Grinch Stole Christmas (1966): The Grinch ties one antler on Max the dog and makes him pull the sleigh
How the Grinch Stole Christmas (1966): Little Cindy Lou Who catches the Grinch taking the tree
How the Grinch Stole Christmas (1966): The Grinch's heart grows three sizes and he lifts the whole loaded sleigh
How the Grinch Stole Christmas (1966): The Grinch carves the roast beast at the Whos' feast

judge: Team names the special and the moment (close enough, host's call) within 60 s; naming only the special = partial; any real word from the performer = fail.
